seo.title: Qalam & Ahar — reed pens, soot ink, burnished paper
seo.description: A two-bench workshop cutting reed pens to order, cooking soot ink, and burnishing ahar paper. Lot One opens this winter.

footer.note: Cut, cooked, and burnished at one bench each. Nothing is kept in stock.
